'''Caspiy Football Club''' ({{langx|kk|Футбольный клуб «Каспий»}}) is a Kazakhstani [[association football|football]] club based at the [[Zhastar Stadium]] in [[Aktau]]. The club name derived from [[Caspian Sea]] ({{langx|kk|Каспий теңізі}}), on whose eastern shore Aktau is located. Their best year was 1996, when they finished 4th in the [[Kazakhstan Premier League|Premier League]] and reached the semi-finals of the [[Kazakhstan Cup]]. Since 2001, they were stuck in the First Division, until gaining direct promotion to the top division in the 2019 season."}}
